method: SVG paths parsed with svgpath, converted to absolute coordinates and expanded shorthand, rounded to 12 decimals. Complete canonical path strings must be equal, not filename or approximate image matching.
scope: Retain complete upstream copyright/license text for each selected package in project notices and publication notices. Lucide LICENSE includes both ISC and derived Feather MIT. Apache licensed packages retain LICENSE and any distributed NOTICE. These matches establish an available redistribution grant for identical geometry, not the actual historical import version or template ownership. Ordinary simple geometry may have multiple authors.
